data.name: Hippel
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'hippos', meaning 'horse'. In ancient Greek culture, the horse represented power, strength, and speed. The name Hippel was given to warriors and nobles, reflecting their courageous and noble character.

data.cultural_impact: The name Hippel carries a historical and cultural significance as it is rooted in ancient Greek culture.
